acceptance_criteria.description: Module src/metrics/latency_stats.py provides RollingLatencyTracker class supporting recording numeric sample latencies (ms) with bounded rolling window capacity.
Tracker computes exact min, max, mean, p50, p95, and p99 percentiles; raises ValueError fail-closed if computing stats on an empty sample buffer.
Rolling window correctly evicts oldest samples when window capacity is reached (FIFO order preservation).

Test suite tests/test_latency_stats.py passes 100% via pytest with at least 5 distinct test scenarios covering empty state, single sample, window eviction, percentiles calculation, and invalid inputs.
